name: lifecycle
supersedes: tools/microbench/lifecycle/protocol.json (version 1; h100-r1 and b300-r2 both rejected: per-launch spread 12-67 %, L = 4096 systematically lower)
purpose: Version 1 asked a per-launch quantity to be constant within 10 %; the b300-r2 samples are bimodal across launches (about 1.1 k vs 1.5 k cycles at W = 1, launch-to-launch, i.e. placement / GPC distance under cache-control all), so the spread criterion cannot hold while the engine needs the expected value. Version 1 also counted the kernel's own cold instruction fetch inside the envelope although the engine charges instruction.fetch separately.
probe: tools/microbench/lifecycle/probe/lifecyc.cu unchanged (verbatim), runner run_ncu.sh with 64 launches per variant (first 2 dropped), cells C = 1, S = 0, W in {1, 4, 8, 16, 32}, L in {64, 1024, 4096}; C = 2 and S = 64 KiB reported
engine_rule_declared_before_data: cycles(job) = core timeline (including instruction.fetch of the kernel's code) + envelope_cycles(launch_warps_per_cta); the envelope therefore excludes the probe kernel's own instruction fetch
derivation: per launch: env = sm__cycles_active.max - max over SMs of the marker span - fetch(probe kernel), where fetch(probe kernel) = the installed instruction.fetch model's cost for the probe kernel's code bytes before the first marker (cold, from the SASS size of the kernel prologue up to the first clock read; computed by model.py from the installed device leaf and recorded); envelope(W) = mean over launches and over L

acceptance.cell: se(mean env) / mean <= 3 % in both runs, run agreement <= 5 %, and |mean env(L = 4096) - mean env(L = 64)| <= 10 % -> measured; else experimental with the per-L means recorded
acceptance.report: the launch-level distribution (modes) is recorded in model.json

install: kernel.lifecycle envelope_cycles linear points over launch_warps_per_cta from the C = 1, S = 0 cells, both devices (source lifecycle.<device>.<run>, protocol tools/microbench/lifecycle/protocol-v2.json); one two-architecture 450 A/B round
not_allowed: no case-cycle tuning; no values from other machines; no threshold or derivation change after data

addenda.written_before: any v2 run (h100 / b300 v2 data not yet collected)
addenda.text: Transcription corrections against the verbatim probe lifecyc.cu: the body-length axis of the probe is L in {0, 1024, 4096} (not {64, 1024, 4096}) and the dynamic-shared axis is S in {0, 204800 B} (not 64 KiB); the acceptance clause reads |mean env(L = 4096) - mean env(L = 0)| <= 10 %, the install cells are C = 1, S = 0, and C = 2 / S = 204800 are reported. Runner: run_ncu.sh writes run-a / run-b under $A/microbench/lifecycle/<device>-<run>/ with --launches 64; model.py drops launches 0 and 1 of every variant as in version 1.
